main_body: Open wooden rack holding six kegs seen end-on in two tiers (3 over 3), under a top beam and above a base rail
top_band: rows 8-12 at x=16: a brown gradient (L109, L130, L157) with no step of 25 L or more and no distinct edge line. It reads as the front face of the beam, not a surface seen from above.
evidence: The top beam is a flat band whose lightness changes gradually, so it is a vertical plank face with no horizontal surface visible from above. The kegs are drawn as round faces looking straight at the viewer, with no elliptical top or barrel top visible, which is a flat front view. The base rail at rows 28-30 is also a thin front strip with no visible top. The drawing matches the red 'front elevation' example: tidy and detailed but with no top surface.

The kegs carry several wood tones, hoops, bungs and grey frame shading, which sits acceptably next to the reference stall.
